name: Heybassh British English Teacher tools
notes: Paste these as webhook tools on the ElevenLabs agent. Replace BACKEND_URL with http://localhost:7860 while testing locally (use a public tunnel such as ngrok), or your Railway URL after deploy.

tools.name: get_student_lesson
tools.description: Load the student's current British English lesson, CEFR level, strengths, weaknesses, and curriculum details. Call this at the start of every session.

student_id.description: Student identifier. Use john if unknown.

tools.name: save_lesson_progress
tools.description: Save lesson results after teaching or assessing the student. A completed lesson with score 70 or more unlocks the next lesson.

student_id.description: Student identifier. Use john if unknown.

lesson_completed.description: True if the lesson was finished.
